I was quite a regular.
I had some business to do in Myeongdong, so I went there once or twice a week for three months.
However, the response was very different depending on the boss's mood.
When he was kind, he was kind, but when he was unkind, it was really unpleasant.

There was an incident.
Although I was a regular, I didn't know that I wasn't allowed to use my laptop.
I said it was posted on the wall, but when I checked later, it was written on a very small, old piece of paper on the ceiling going up to the second floor.
Anyway, I could have quietly said, “You can’t use your laptop here,” but all the customers were there, but they yelled at me.
“Turn off your laptop and get out!” He kept saying this so I closed the laptop without knowing why he was doing this.
No...it says laptops are not allowed here. If you had calmly told me to turn it off and use the cafe, I would have felt so sorry that I would have covered it up right away and come to the cafe more often.

I wasn't using an electrical cord, and the WiFi was also using my phone's hotspot.
I told you that I didn't use any electricity or wifi at the cafe.
“Oh, I just don’t like this place so don’t use the laptop!!! Get out and I’ll give you a refund!!!” I was embarrassed by the attention being drawn to me, so I quickly packed my bags and left.
I was so angry that I tried to say something to the boss again, but he seemed to be having a hard time communicating.
What is it that you just don't like? There was even a person reading a book who had been to the cafe longer than me and had finished his drink.
I've been playing here for 3 hours. Why don't you say anything about books or studying?? Even though the store was about half full?
And even though they yelled at me for a refund, they didn't give me a refund. Ha... I'm getting angry again while writing this...

Oh, honestly, it doesn't taste good...I just go there for the atmosphere.

It was three months ago, but it went viral on Instagram these days, so I'm leaving a review to let people know about the owner's customer service, inadequate service, and moodiness.

Ah, when he was in a good mood or was kind, when coffee was served, he would say to me, “Everyone is taking videos, but why aren’t you taking pictures?” He joked first.
A true legend, I'm in a bad mood.

There are more days when I don't take pictures, but I was a regular like this.

Conclusion: This is a place where the owner's response makes you feel bad.

1. Strawberry waffle
Strawberries, yogurt ice cream, and whipped cream are on top of the waffle. It tastes similar to the light cream that goes on whipped cream cakes, but is a little softer and more chewy. Even though it was on a warm waffle, it maintained its texture over time, which was very nice.

2. Green tea shaved ice for 1 person
It is topped with green tea ice, glutinous rice cake, red beans, green tea ice cream, and nuts. The ice itself tastes like green tea, so it's delicious no matter which part you eat, and the red beans are in the middle of the ice, so you don't have to mix them. reviews.author: Jihoo Hwang
reviews.text:
First, you sit down and order and pay at the counter located on the second floor. Drinks will be brought to your seat by staff. Employees also clean up the space.

Milk tea, cafe latte, and waffles with whipped cream seem to be famous. They probably seem good at handling dairy products. We also offer a wide range of non-caffeinated beverages such as traditional tea and fresh fruit juice.

The table doesn't wobble and the chairs are comfortable. Most of them are made up of sofas and armchairs, making them great for relaxing. The sofa seats 4 people, and the 6 seater is a regular chair.

The men's restroom is on the 2nd floor and the women's restroom is on the 3rd floor. The bathroom is a bit small but clean. There is only one space for each, so you have to wait if someone uses it first. Soap and paper towels are also provided, so you don't have any trouble washing your hands.

There is a smoking area on the 3rd floor. Matches are provided. The smoking area is not well airtight, so if there are many people smoking, smoke may leak out. If you want to avoid cigarette smoke, we recommend taking a seat on the second floor.

reviews.author: HT KIM
reviews.text:
This cafe is located inside 1898, underneath Myeongdong Cathedral. Even though I've been to Myeongdong Cathedral countless times, I've never been to Jeon Kwang-soo Coffee House, thinking it was just a cafe along the way. However, after visiting for the first time, I realized that it was a more professional cafe than I expected. When I first encountered 'Siphon Coffee' in Japan some time ago, I thought it was a very good coffee that was fun to watch the making process, fun to the nose to smell, and fun to drink. However, surprisingly, siphon coffee was being sold at a nearby place, but I was completely unaware of it. Unfortunately, I wasn't in a position to enjoy coffee this time, so I ordered decaffeinated Americano instead of siphon coffee.

[Price as of April 2024]
- Decaffeinated Iced Americano 6,000 won
- Crople 6,000 won

During my stay here, I observed that unfortunately not many people order siphon coffee. Maybe it's because the price is more expensive than Americano. If you order "Coffee of the Day," they say it will be brewed using a siphon, but the price is the same as usual. I thought that more people would be able to enjoy Siphon Coffee if they gave a small discount on “Coffee of the Day.”

In the past, there were many Jeon Gwangsu Coffee Houses all over the country, but the branch near my house recently closed. I remember that it had been in business for about 15 years at that location, but I blamed myself for finding out about Jeon Kwang-soo Coffee House too late and promised myself that I would definitely try Siphon Coffee at another branch nearby.

I remember Jeon Kwang-soo Coffee House Myeongdong Cathedral branch being crowded whenever I went there. This cafe is quite popular, so I recommend visiting at least once if you happen to be nearby.

Hipjiro also has something like this... It's a cafe and bar with an airplane concept.

There is an airport electronic display board right from the entrance, so it is not difficult to find even though it is located in an alley. Once inside, the counter is set up like an airport check-in, and most of the menus are general, but there is also a menu with an in-flight meal concept. The bathroom is also designed like an airplane bathroom, and the takeoff announcement is played inside.

What stands out the most is the airplane cabin-style seats, but because they are so popular, there is a 90-minute time limit. Luckily, it was empty when I went so I was able to sit down. Of course, there are many regular seats, and the front row of seats is reserved as a photo spot, so taking photos is no problem.

The Einspänner is memorable because the cream on top has a marshmallow-like chewy texture. Tiramisu is only in name, but it was actually closer to a chocolate cake, but it was still delicious.

It's a cafe that's very faithful to its concept, and the food quality is better than I expected, so it might be a good idea to give it a try!

reviews.author: ssin Kim
reviews.text:
I recommend it as a space for young people in Euljiro.

First of all, the drinks are so delicious. Highly recommended drink!
I ordered two signature drinks.
I ordered a creme brûlée latte and a real vanilla bean latte.
It's literally JMT.
In particular, the real vanilla bean latte has heavy milk and a rich flavor. I felt that and was able to enjoy the flavor of milk!

I was so full for dessert that I only ordered the Mint Chocolate Basque Cheesecake. This menu was very delicious with the softness of the Basque cheesecake, but the mint flavor was strong, so I recommend it to those who are very picky (this is my personal opinion).
Next time, I wanted to try the pound cake, apple crumble, madeleine, and corn Basque cheesecake.

The spaces on the 1st and 2nd floors seem similar, so you can choose a different atmosphere. As the name of the sign suggests, lighting is used appropriately in the space, so the 2nd floor will have a nice atmosphere when the sun goes down.

The space is utilized so you can put things in the milk box(?) under the seat, and it's also fun to choose a slightly different seat to sit on.

Even though it's not spacious, it's a cafe that feels like a lot of thought was put into it.
I am 200% willing to come back again, even if it's just because I'm looking forward to the desserts I couldn't finish.

Enjoy a leisurely breakfast.

This store is a small cafe near the Nine Tree Hotel. It opens early, around 8am, so you can grab breakfast and head out even if you have a late-night flight.

The signature caramel milk coffee here is served in a small cup with fresh milk and rich caramel mixed with coffee. It's really delicious! 😋 There are two types of toast, which are also pretty good.
